entities.name: Wollmar Boström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wollmar Filip Boström was a Swedish diplomat and tennis player. He competed at the 1908 and 1912 Olympics in singles and men's doubles and won a bronze medal in the doubles in 1908, finishing fifth in three other events.
